title: QA orientation: task handoffs and privacy
warning: SYNTHETIC QA ONLY - NOT A REAL PERSON, VACANCY OR EMPLOYMENT RECORD.
body: In this fictional workplace, the staff member keeps a task list with a clear next action and owner. A task is complete only after the expected handoff is confirmed.
Use only your own app identity. Review the recipient and your authority before sharing a document or message. Nonclinical staff route clinical questions to an authorized clinician.
When a record is missing or a deadline conflicts, ask People Operations through the intended message path. Do not change another person's work or mark prerequisites complete to clear a checklist.
Setting a password is a setup step. Employee access starts after the required onboarding and staff approval. Keep passwords and personal portal links in the QA vault.
This is a short QA resource, not ITSCO's actual employee handbook or a legal policy. Reading this file alone does not pass required company training.

questions.question: A clinical question reaches a nonclinical coordinator. What should they do?
options: Route it to an authorized clinician
Mark the request complete without a handoff

questions.question: A new candidate has set a password but is waiting for approval. Are they active?
options: No, normal onboarding and staff approval still apply

questions.question: Where should a private candidate token be stored?

reflectionPrompt: Write one sentence about confirming the owner of the next action.
syntheticReflectionExample: I would confirm who owns the next step before closing the handoff.
completionInstruction: Use the app's real reading, quiz and retry rules. Do not invent completed time, another person's answer or a real training credential.
